scope: Follow-up local skill improvements; not release acceptance

improvements.name: same_tick_income_and_spending
improvements.behavior: Aggregate per holder and resource at each story tick; block unavoidable shortfalls, warn about required same-tick funding order, retain net balance for following ticks.

improvements.name: world_check_snapshot
improvements.behavior: Read plan and evidence in one snapshot and bind returned book_id, chapter and revision.

improvements.name: read_only_history_dependencies
improvements.behavior: history-deps --chapter reads the complete published declaration without a plan, branch or mutation; preserves original hashes and keeps reviewed --input/--expect writes compatible.

unit_tests.counting: Successful test cases use addSuccess; failure/error/skip counts may include subtests

local_links.scope: Inline local Markdown file targets; remote URLs and heading anchors are not checked

independent_skill_exercises.method: Separate agent read relevant skill instructions and used real CLI, without diff, tests or implementation; synthetic books were cleaned.

limits: Executed on Intel macOS only; conditional skips are not passes.
No GitHub push, release, package publication or update of the real installed skills.
No new token, capacity, migration or literary quality benchmark. Previous validation artifacts are preserved as their original point-in-time records.
